reading.body:
The QTS New Albany 2 DC2 facility sits at 675 Beech Rd SW in New Albany, Ohio, part of a campus serving the Columbus area with closed-loop cooling. The operator has published no megawatt capacity, square footage, or per-building power figures for this site.

Ohio has five mapped data center facilities and no published capacity figures from any operator. This campus ranks first among them only because no others have disclosed power either, making the ranking meaningless for assessing scale.

Without published power or IT load capacity, this facility cannot be evaluated for its role in AI infrastructure scaling. The binding constraints that determine whether a campus matters to AI compute cannot be read from available data.
